threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look baffled when the bus driver shouts 'Stand clear of the doors!' before every stop. Classic sign you’re fresh to the area.
Last night on the 45, a guy serenaded the whole bus with an off-key version of 'Wonderwall' while the driver just shook his head. Always something happening at that hour.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a kid trading Pokémon cards for kebab slices at the playground. That’s when it hit me—Neukölln is a world of its own.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find street vendors selling currywurst at 3 AM, while local musicians turn the sidewalk into an open-air concert.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their ability to navigate the BART delays without breaking a sweat, while tourists just stare at their phones.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus that stopped mid-ride because the driver saw a friend outside. We waited five minutes while they chatted. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just pick any bar for a shot of absinthe. The locals know which ones actually serve the good stuff and aren't just tourist traps.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You'll catch them fumbling with the T-10 card at the metro station, staring blankly at the vending machines like they're from another planet.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: If you ask about the best tube line, then gasp at the answer, you're definitely new. Everyone knows it's all about the Overground here.
Heard a guy on the 196 bus bragging about sneaking in a takeaway to impress his date. He accidentally dropped his kebab right before getting off.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a group of kids using an old fountain as a makeshift stage for a rap battle, completely ignoring the world around them.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a currywurst stand that also serves vegan versions, complete with homemade sauces that change weekly. A total game-changer.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a local by how they navigate around a BART delay. They'll take the bus, but only if they know the driver’s coffee order.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy pull out an accordion on the 31 while the bus was stuck in traffic. Instant mood lifter amid all the delays—classic SF moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think we all love 'la vida nocturna', but many locals just want a quiet evening after the noise of the earlier crowds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They always take a photo with the giant mosaic at Park Güell, trying to capture the ‘authentic’ vibe, not realizing locals avoid it like the plague.
